libero: OSC_POSE: [dx,dy,dz,rx,ry,rz,gripper]. Normalized Cartesian delta pose in world frame. Translation scale 0.05 m, rotation scale 0.5 rad before controller dynamics. Gripper -1 opens, +1 closes.
metaworld: Sawyer: [dx,dy,dz,gripper]. Cartesian delta translation in world frame. Gripper -1 opens, +1 closes. Use small actions near objects.
maniskill3: Panda pd_ee_delta_pose: [dx,dy,dz,rx,ry,rz,gripper]. Normalized delta end-effector pose; rotation is an axis-angle delta, not absolute Euler angles. Gripper +1 opens, -1 closes.
robocasa: PandaOmron 12D: [dx,dy,dz,rx,ry,rz,gripper,base_x,base_y,base_yaw,torso,mode]. Gripper -1 opens, +1 closes. Set mode=-1 for arm mode, mode=+1 for base mode. Keep unused dimensions zero. The native composite controller determines the active frame. Inspect visual feedback before committing large motions.
